Corporate programs

Coaching programs for your tech team

If your company wants to develop its people, I run fixed-length programs with a clear plan, something concrete to show after every session, and a 90-day plan at the end.

Discuss a program

6 or 12 weeks · Priced per participant · Cohorts for teams of 4+

Programs

Two tracks, two lengths each

Each track comes as a 6-session intensive for an urgent need, or a 12-week program for change that lasts. Prices are per participant.

Track 1

Career Accelerator

For people moving into a new role, company or country: internal moves, relocation or outplacement. We work on the CV, LinkedIn, the job search and interviews.

Intensive Sprint · 6 sessions

€615–700

  • CV, LinkedIn and interview preparation
  • One mock interview with feedback
  • Core templates included
  • Best when the interviews have already started
Full Program · 12 weeks

€1,050–1,315

  • 12 weekly sessions of 55–60 minutes
  • Two full mock interviews with written feedback
  • CV templates, a job-search tracker and hiring guides for each market
  • Support by message between sessions
  • A 90-day plan to keep going after the program
Track 2

Executive Edge

For managers, directors and senior leaders stepping into bigger roles at international companies. We work on presence, influence, panel interviews and negotiating at a senior level.

Senior Interview Intensive · 6 sessions

€875–1,050

  • A communication assessment in the first session
  • Presence, panel interviews and negotiation
  • One mock panel interview with written debrief
  • A bank of PAR stories and useful phrases for senior conversations
Full Executive Program · 12 weeks

€1,755–2,190

  • 12 sessions of 60–75 minutes
  • A full assessment of leadership and communication
  • Two mock panel interviews with written debrief
  • Support by message between sessions
  • A 90-day plan and a check-in with me 60 days later
In every program

Every session ends with something done

Participants don’t just listen. Each week they leave with something finished: a rewritten CV, a recorded pitch, a stakeholder map, a negotiation script.

  • The PAR method and role-plays throughout
  • Recording and playing back practice, so people hear themselves
  • Advice for specific markets: the UK, US, Germany, the Netherlands and Switzerland
  • Homework between sessions
  • A monthly check on progress against the plan
How it starts

We check it’s a good fit before anyone commits

  1. A short form

    Each participant tells me their current role, the role or level they’re aiming for, the market and their biggest obstacle.

  2. A first call

    30 minutes for Career Accelerator, 45 for Executive Edge, to agree the format and make sure it’s a good fit.

  3. Assessment

    In the first session I assess where each participant is and write a plan for them.

  4. Weekly sessions

    Same day and time each week, online. Sessions can be recorded if everyone agrees.

Questions

Corporate program questions

Are prices per participant?

Yes. Where the price lands within each range depends on what we agree on the first call. For teams of four or more, I also run group programs.

Can the two tracks be combined?

Yes. If a senior participant also needs help with the job search itself, we can mix the two. We agree the details on the first call.

What English level do participants need?

Working professional English (B2 or above). If language is the main barrier, communication coaching is a better place to start.

Do you provide invoices?

Yes. I can send invoices and receipts whenever you need them.
